To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
protons are dominant at the knee energy of the all-particles spectrum, and that nuclei heavier than helium dominate at higher energies.

the energy spectrum of primary protons is expressed by a single-power-law function with a spectral index − 3.03 ± 0.08 and the absolute flux of protons is ( 2.2 ± 0.7 ) × 10 − 3 m − 2 s − 1 sr − 1 in the energy range between 10 15 and 10 17 eV.

the proton and helium energy spectra are measured for the first time at the knee energy range by selecting events of high energy core and primary mass, and that the main component of the knee is nuclei heavier than helium, which is consistent with the result of the Tibet air-shower experiment.
